# Skeleton

**Figma:** Skeleton/Body-Text, Heading-Text, Shapes (page 1556:17503)  
**Import:** `import { SkeletonText, SkeletonHeading, SkeletonShape } from "@zen-ds/react";`

Placeholder that mirrors the layout of content while it loads.

## Use it for
- Initial loads of cards, lists and profiles whose layout is known.

## Use something else for
- Actions in progress on a button → the button's busy label.
- Measurable progress → Progress.
- Instant loads (< ~300ms); show nothing.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Body-Text | `SkeletonText lines` | 1 · 2 · 3 · 5 lines, last line shorter |
| Heading-Text | `SkeletonHeading size` | small (16) · medium (24) · large (32) |
| Shapes | `SkeletonShape shape · size` | rectangle · pill · round · square × 2xsmall–large |
| Motion | `animated` | shimmer; off with reduced motion |

## ✅ Do
- Match the final layout: avatar → round shape, title → heading, paragraph → text lines.
- Wrap the loading region in aria-busy=true with a visually hidden “Loading…” status.
- Swap to real content in one step.
- Respect reduced motion: the pulse turns off (harness: motion/reduced-motion).

## ❌ Don't
- Don't show skeletons for content that loads instantly.
- Don't use one big block for everything; it hides the structure.
- Don't keep a skeleton on screen indefinitely; show an error or empty state.

## Accessibility
- Skeleton pieces are aria-hidden; announce loading once on the container (aria-busy + role=status).

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `motion/reduced-motion` | warn | Every animation, and every transition that moves (transform, translate, scale, rotate), has a reduced-motion fallback in the same file: a prefers-reduced-motion block, or distances multiplied by --zen-motion-movement (0 under reduced motion). Fades and colour changes need none. | `zen-allow-motion: <reason>` |
| `motion/token-only` | warn | Transitions and animations take their duration and curve from the motion tokens (--zen-motion-duration-xfast/fast/base/slow, --zen-motion-ease-standard/emphasized/exit/linear); endless loops (infinite) are exempt. | `zen-allow-motion-token: <reason>` |
| `motion/no-layout-animation` | warn | Animate transform, opacity and colours; expand and collapse with grid-template-rows. Animating width, height, top/left or margin re-lays out the page every frame. | `zen-allow-motion-layout: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
